title: Build an Asset Loan Tracker website
paragraphs: Pillar 5 wants a small website called **Asset Loan Tracker** so that staff can borrow equipment and the ICT team can see who has what. In this section you will show that you can read a form, check it, save it, and display it again in a useful way.

**1. The home page.** It must have a heading, a short welcome message and a form with four inputs: a text box for the person's **name**; a dropdown to choose the **asset** (Laptop, Projector, Router, Tablet); a number box for the **number of days** they want it (1 to 14); and a larger text box for the **reason**. The form must end with a Submit button.

**2. The reply page.** When the person clicks Submit, show a reply page that greets them by name, repeats the asset, days and reason, and gives the loan a number in this format: `LN-001`, `LN-002`, and so on, going up by one for every loan that is saved. It must also show the **return date** (today plus the number of days) and a short message that depends on the asset, for example "Collect the projector and its cable from the ICT office."

**3. Stock.** The company owns only this many of each item: **Laptop 3, Projector 1, Router 2, Tablet 2**. If every item of that type is already out on loan, show an error and do not save the request.

**4. Saving.** Every loan must be saved in a `loans.json` file so that nothing is lost when the server restarts, and the loan numbers must carry on counting from where they stopped. The program must not crash if the file does not exist yet. Each saved loan must have a status of **Active** or **Returned**.

**5. The /loans page.** Create a second page at the address `/loans` that shows all saved loans in a table with the loan number, name, asset, days, return date, reason and status. It must also show how many of each asset are available right now. Next to every Active loan there must be a **Return** button. When it is clicked the status changes to Returned and that item becomes available again.

**6. Checking the input.** Show a clear error message and do not save the request if: the name is empty; the reason is shorter than 15 characters; the days are not a whole number from 1 to 14; or the chosen asset has no stock left. If there are several problems, show all of them. Keep what the person already typed in the form when you show the errors.

**7. Code quality.** Use Python with Flask (recommended). Use clear names and at least **three functions** so you do not repeat code, for example one to load the data, one to save it and one to check the input. You may search online, but you must be able to explain every part of your code when asked.
**Bonus, up to 4 marks:** (a) add a page at `/api/loans` that returns all loans as JSON (2 marks); (b) add a search box and a status filter (All, Active, Returned) on the /loans page (2 marks).
marking_line: How Section B is marked: the form 4, reading the input and the reply page 6, saving to the file and the /loans page 6, the checks and the stock rule 6, the Return button 4, neat code and your explanation of it 4. Total 30, plus up to 4 bonus marks.
